_doc: Golden hashes of our Project Nested fork, checked by 'brokendev.ps1 nested test'. Core: tools/nestedasm/test_nestedasm.py in the fork pins the pristine v1.8 core (md5 0aa40023...) and the md5 of every NESTED_STEP 1-18 (step 18 = 57c4a845..., profile vrun). Releases: the released SNES ROM rebuilt from its NES ROM (identified by sha256), its m30pipe game profile and the core assembled from source must be byte-identical. The ROMs live in Releases (outside git); a release whose NES ROM is missing is reported SKIPPED, never passed.

releases.what: Nested VRUN SNES, the 2026-11-07 speed release (VRUN 439616b --nested, entry points from BrokenNes feedback)
